name: Bank Danych Lokalnych
notes: Largest Polish local statistics DB. Anonymous access works but api_key raises limits (5→10 req/s). Header: X-ClientId.

name: Dziedzinowe Bazy Wiedzy
notes: Thematic knowledge bases. Same rate limits as BDL. Docs at api-dbw.stat.gov.pl/apidocs.

name: Składnica Danych Publikacyjnych
notes: Full public statistics — data and metadata in consistent structure. Docs at api-sdp.stat.gov.pl/apidocs.

name: System Monitorowania Usług Publicznych
notes: Public services monitoring at municipality level.

name: Strateg
notes: Regional development and social cohesion monitoring.

name: Krajowa Platforma Raportująca SDG
notes: UN Sustainable Development Goals monitoring for Poland.

name: Rejestr REGON
notes: Official Polish business register. Requires registration. Returns XML only.

name: Rejestr TERYT
notes: Official administrative division codes and names. Historical data available.

name: TranStat
notes: Experimental road and maritime transport statistics.

name: Bank Danych Makroekonomicznych
notes: Key macroeconomic indicators. No public API — file downloads only.

name: Baza Demografia
notes: Demographic data portal. File download only.

name: Bank Danych Polska
notes: Multi-sector local statistics. File download only.

name: Dekompozycje
notes: Statistical decomposition analyses. File download only.

name: Eurostat
notes: Main EU statistical office. REST API with SDMX support. No auth required.

name: OECD Data Explorer
notes: OECD macroeconomic and policy data. SDMX REST API.

name: World Development Indicators
notes: Global development indicators. Free REST API — no auth required.

name: ILOSTAT
notes: International Labour Organization statistics. SDMX REST API.

name: World Economic Outlook
notes: IMF macroeconomic data for most countries. Free API.

name: FAOSTAT
notes: UN Food and Agriculture data. Free REST API.

name: WTO STATS
notes: World trade statistics. Free API key required after registration.

name: UN World Population Prospects
notes: UN demographic estimates and projections to 2100 by age and sex.

name: Narodowy Bank Polski
notes: Exchange rates (tables A/B/C) and gold prices. No auth. Max 93-day window per query. JSON and XML available. HTTPS mandatory since Aug 2025.

name: Giełda Papierów Wartościowych
notes: Warsaw Stock Exchange prices and indices. No public REST API — historical data downloadable as CSV/XLS from the website.

name: Komisja Nadzoru Finansowego
notes: Financial sector supervisory statistics: banking, insurance, capital markets, payment services. File downloads only. No public API.

name: Narodowy Fundusz Zdrowia
notes: Hospital procedure statistics (JGP/DRG groups). JSON API (JSON:API spec). No auth. Covers hospitalisations by gender, age, diagnosis, ICD-10, procedure.

name: Główny Inspektorat Sanitarny
notes: Epidemiological surveillance: communicable diseases, foodborne outbreaks, vaccination coverage. Periodic Excel reports. No public API.

name: Polskie Sieci Elektroenergetyczne
notes: Electricity grid operations: generation by source, cross-border flows, system balancing, demand. Near real-time and historical data. No auth required.

name: Urząd Regulacji Energetyki
notes: Energy regulatory data: tariff approvals and sector statistics. Annual reports and Excel files. No public API.

name: Główny Inspektorat Ochrony Środowiska
notes: Air quality monitoring (JPOAT network). JSON-LD API. Rate limit ~2 req/min. Covers PM2.5, PM10, NO2, SO2, O3 at national stations.

name: Krajowy Ośrodek Bilansowania i Zarządzania Emisjami
notes: National GHG emissions inventory and projections (UNFCCC/EU reporting). Excel and PDF publications. No public API.

name: Urząd Transportu Kolejowego
notes: Railway transport statistics open data portal: passenger numbers and freight by operator. JSON and CSV downloads. No auth.

name: Generalna Dyrekcja Dróg Krajowych i Autostrad
notes: National road network access point (EKSD/KPD): road conditions and traffic counts. JSON API. No auth.

name: Krajowy Ośrodek Wsparcia Rolnictwa
notes: Agricultural market support data: state farmland sales and market interventions. Excel reports. No public API.

name: Agencja Restrukturyzacji i Modernizacji Rolnictwa
notes: EU agricultural subsidy payments (CAP direct payments, rural development). File downloads. No public API.

name: Portal Otwartych Danych
notes: Polish national open data portal aggregating datasets from ministries and agencies. JSON:API format. No auth. Supports filtering and pagination.

name: Zakład Ubezpieczeń Społecznych
notes: Social insurance statistics: pension recipients, benefits, employment registrations, insured persons. Excel reports via ZUS statistical portal.

name: Ministerstwo Rodziny i Polityki Społecznej
notes: Labour and social policy statistics from employment offices: registered unemployment, job offers, benefits. Monthly Excel files.

name: Ministerstwo Finansów — Dane Budżetowe
notes: Public finance statistics: budget execution, tax revenues by type, public debt. Monthly and annual Excel publications.

name: Komenda Główna Policji — Statystyki
notes: Crime statistics by type, voivodeship, and year. Road accident data. Annual Excel files from Police HQ.

name: Ministerstwo Sprawiedliwości — Statystyki Sądowe
notes: Judicial statistics: court proceedings, convictions, prison population, legal aid. Annual Excel from Ministry of Justice.

name: Urząd Komunikacji Elektronicznej
notes: Telecom and internet market data: broadband penetration, mobile subscribers, postal services. Annual Excel reports.

name: Polska Organizacja Turystyczna
notes: Tourism statistics: inbound/outbound travel and tourist accommodation. Excel reports and publications.

name: European Central Bank
notes: Euro area monetary statistics, exchange rates, interest rates, and banking sector data. SDMX 2.1 REST API. No auth. Supports JSON, CSV, and SDMX-ML formats.

name: Towarowa Giełda Energii
notes: Polish Power Exchange: electricity spot and forward prices, gas prices, CO2 certificate (EUA) prices. File downloads. No public REST API. Also relevant for ENE domain.

name: GPW Benchmark
notes: Polish interbank reference rates: WIBOR (1M, 3M, 6M, 12M) and WIRON. Daily Excel/CSV files. WIBOR being phased out and replaced by WIRON.

name: Bank for International Settlements
notes: International banking statistics, cross-border flows, debt securities, and derivatives markets. SDMX REST API. No auth required.

name: Krajowa Administracja Skarbowa
notes: Tax collection statistics by type: VAT, PIT, CIT, excise, customs duties. Monthly Excel publications. Data also available via dane.gov.pl. No public API.

name: Ministerstwo Finansów — Dług Publiczny
notes: Public debt portal: Treasury bond auction results, yield curve, debt structure by instrument and holder type. Monthly Excel publications. No public API.

name: Bank Gospodarstwa Krajowego
notes: State development bank: public investment loans, EU fund disbursements, guarantee schemes, housing programmes. Quarterly and annual reports. No public API.

name: EC Business and Consumer Surveys
notes: European Commission economic sentiment indicator (ESI), business and consumer confidence surveys for all EU member states including Poland. API access via new data browser. Also available as XLSX/SDMX-CSV bulk downloads.

name: Urząd Ochrony Konkurencji i Konsumentów
notes: Consumer market monitoring, price transparency reports, and competition enforcement decisions. File downloads. No public API.

name: Centralna Baza Ofert Pracy
notes: Central job vacancies database from Polish public employment offices. Data exposed via dane.gov.pl. No documented standalone REST API.

name: Barometr Pracuj
notes: Periodic salary and labour market reports (Barometr Pracuj). Published 2–3 times per year as Excel/PDF. No API or raw data access. Covers salary ranges by role and region.

name: LinkedIn Economic Graph
notes: Published labour market insights: job posting trends, skills demand, hiring rates. No open API or raw data downloads. Reports and articles only. Poland covered as part of EU/EMEA.

name: Główny Urząd Nadzoru Budowlanego
notes: Building permits and construction starts by type, region, and investor category. Downloadable as CSV. No public REST API.

name: S&P Global PMI Poland
notes: Purchasing Managers Index for Polish manufacturing and services. Monthly press releases with headline index and sub-indices. No raw data API — report/article format only.

name: UN Comtrade
notes: International merchandise trade statistics by country, commodity (HS), and flow. Free subscription tier available. API key required after registration.

name: Platforma Usług Elektronicznych Służby Celno-Skarbowej
notes: Polish customs clearance platform. Aggregate trade and customs duty statistics. File downloads. No public open data API.

name: Ministerstwo Rolnictwa i Rozwoju Wsi
notes: Agricultural policy data: crop area declarations, market interventions, subsidy schemes. File downloads. No public API.

name: Lasy Państwowe
notes: State Forests annual statistics: timber harvest, forest area, biodiversity, employment. Annual Excel reports. No public API.

name: Instytut Uprawy Nawożenia i Gleboznawstwa
notes: Agrometeorology and soil science data: drought monitoring (KSM), soil maps, agroclimatic conditions. File downloads and published bulletins.

name: Urząd Lotnictwa Cywilnego
notes: Civil aviation statistics: passenger numbers, aircraft movements, airport traffic, airline licences. Annual Excel reports. No public API.

name: PKP Polskie Linie Kolejowe
notes: Railway infrastructure statistics: track length, traffic volumes, punctuality, investment. Annual Excel reports. No public API.

name: Agencja Rynku Energii
notes: Detailed energy sector statistics: electricity and heat generation by fuel, fuel consumption, capacity. Monthly and annual Excel publications.

name: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform
notes: European electricity grid data: generation by source, cross-border flows, load, prices. RESTful API returning XML. Free API key required after registration. Covers all EU member states.

name: International Energy Agency
notes: Global energy statistics: supply, demand, prices, CO2 emissions by country and fuel. JSON REST API. Free key required. Annual and monthly datasets.

name: Instytut Meteorologii i Gospodarki Wodnej
notes: Meteorological and hydrological real-time and historical data from national monitoring network. JSON REST API. No auth for public data. Covers weather stations and river gauges.

name: European Environment Agency
notes: European environmental indicators: air quality, emissions, land use, biodiversity, water. REST API and bulk downloads. No auth required for most datasets.

name: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service
notes: EU Earth observation: land cover, urban footprint, vegetation, soil moisture, snow cover. REST API and bulk downloads. No auth for most datasets.

name: Państwowe Gospodarstwo Wodne Wody Polskie
notes: Water management statistics: river flows, flood risk, water permits, water use by sector. Annual Excel reports. No public API.

name: World Health Organization
notes: Global Health Observatory: mortality, disease burden, health system indicators by country. OData REST API. No auth required.

name: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control
notes: Communicable disease surveillance across EU: weekly case counts by disease and country. Open data downloads and API. No auth required.

name: Narodowy Instytut Zdrowia Publicznego — PZH
notes: Public health epidemiological data: infectious diseases, cancer registry, vaccination coverage, poisonings. Annual Excel reports and bulletins.

name: System Informacji Oświatowej
notes: School Information System: pupil numbers, teachers, schools by type and region. Annual Excel data files from Ministry of Education. No public API.

name: System POL-on
notes: Higher education information system: student numbers, graduates, academic staff, institutions. Annual Excel exports. No public API.

name: Państwowy Fundusz Rehabilitacji Osób Niepełnosprawnych
notes: Disability fund statistics: registered disabled persons, employment support, subsidies paid to employers. Annual Excel reports.

name: Służba Więzienna
notes: Prison Service statistics: prison population by type, gender, offence category, recidivism. Annual Excel reports. No public API.

name: Prokuratura Krajowa — Statystyki
notes: Prosecution statistics: cases initiated, indictments, discontinuations by offence type. Annual Excel publications.

name: Ministerstwo Kultury i Dziedzictwa Narodowego
notes: Culture statistics: attendance at theatres, cinemas, museums, libraries. EU cultural participation data. Annual Excel files.

name: Ministerstwo Sportu i Turystyki
notes: Sport infrastructure and participation statistics: sports clubs, licensed athletes, sport facilities by region. Annual Excel reports.

name: Biblioteka Narodowa
notes: Reading and library statistics: book loans, library visits, publishing output, readership surveys. Annual Excel reports.

name: Ośrodek Przetwarzania Informacji — PIB
notes: R&D and innovation statistics: research expenditure, personnel, publications, patents by institution and field. Annual Excel data.

name: Narodowe Centrum Nauki
notes: National Science Centre: granted research projects, funding amounts, disciplines. Annual Excel reports. No public API.

name: NASK — Państwowy Instytut Badawczy
notes: Internet infrastructure and cybersecurity reports: domain registrations, broadband coverage, threat landscape. Annual reports in PDF/HTML. No structured data API.

name: AMECO — Annual Macro-Economic Database
notes: EC annual macro-economic database: long time series for GDP, investment, savings, employment, wages, prices across EU member states. Bulk Excel downloads. Updated with spring and autumn forecasts.

name: Gaz-System — Dane Transparentności
notes: Polish gas transmission system operator. Gas flow data (entry/exit points, storage, cross-border) published via ENTSOG Transparency Platform REST API. No auth required.

name: Centrum e-Zdrowia
notes: Health information system centre: cancer registry, hospital register, medical staff register, e-prescription statistics. Annual Excel publications. No public API.
